    Browse the CTTIR v5 identities

    Source: R/cttir-library.R
    hex_catalog.Rd

    The registry includes 37 R packages, five companion apps, two suites and the CTTIR organisation identity. Exact spelling and case are preserved.

    Usage

    hex_catalog(family = NULL)

    Arguments

    family

    Optional family key used to filter the registry.

    Value

    A data frame with identity, repository, family, symbol, kind and source.

    Examples

    hex_catalog()
#>               name            repo     family          symbol          kind
